CHECK BURST CS-asm-fg-v4-band — assemble the cliffside FOREGROUND canvas from 17 outpainted chunks with minimum-error seams, then fill a painted CLOUD BANK band over the lower cliff faces from the depth map (Matt R-C3-48/54-60; R-C3-69; v4.1 geometry). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-asm-fg-v4-band".

Inputs (read-only): /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/chunks_v4.json (paint_order: each chunk's index [cx,cy], origin_px, files; canvas 5376×4096; chunk 1536×1024; step 1280×768); painted chunks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-v4-<cx>_<cy>/chunk_<cx>_<cy>.png (flat #00ff00 = void) — where a re-drive directory CS-v4-<cx>_<cy>-r1/ exists use it instead of the original; per-chunk masks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/chunk_<cx>_<cy>_mask.png; the full-canvas DEPTH map /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/ortho_canvas_v4_depth_mm.png (uint16 mm below rim; 65535 = not foreground) and mask /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/ortho_canvas_v4_mask.png. Frozen tool /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py (extract, edge_mode='clamp'). python glue with PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files; work in RAM carefully (the canvas is 5376×4096 RGBA).

STEP 1 — per chunk: RGBA = clamp-matte of the painted chunk; alpha restricted to that chunk's mask dilated by 6 px.
STEP 2 — composite in paint_order onto a transparent 5376×4096 canvas. For each chunk, inside every overlap with pixels already placed, cut along a MINIMUM-ERROR path (cost = mean |RGB| between existing and new where both are opaque; where only one is opaque it wins; DP ±1 px per step; vertical path for left overlaps, horizontal for top overlaps; a corner square goes to the lower-cost side), feather ±3 px. Record per seam: chunk pair, path mean cost, p95.
STEP 3 — BASE: the STEP 2 canvas with alpha from the matte ONLY (NO depth fade at all).
STEP 4 — TEXTURE: tiles /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-cloudtex-a/cloudtex_a.png and /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-cloudtex-b/cloudtex_b.png (1536×1024 each, left/right edges tileable). Fill a 5376×4096 cloud canvas: rows of tiles stepping 864 px vertically (160-px vertical overlap, linear crossfade), alternating a/b along each row and between rows, each row shifted horizontally by 768 px × row index (wrap). Report the measured mean |RGB| across each tile's left/right wrap seam (8-px bands).
STEP 5 — BAND ALPHA from the canvas depth map d (mm; 0 = top surfaces; 65535 = not foreground): N = smooth fractal noise in [0,1] (seed 7, 3 octaves, wavelengths 420/210/105 px); L = luminance of the cloud canvas, 9-px Gaussian blur, normalised to [0,1] by its 2nd–98th percentiles. FACE pixels (0 < d < 65535): F = clip((d − (11000 + (N − 0.5)·5000)) / 1500, −2, 2). VOID pixels (d = 65535): g = vertical distance in px DOWN from the nearest FACE pixel directly above in the same column (search ≤ 400 px, else none); if found, U = 100 + 160·N and F = clip((U − g)/40, −2, 2), else F = −2. TOP pixels (d = 0): F = −2. Raw a = clip(0.5 + 0.9·F + 1.2·(L − 0.5), 0, 1); a = smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, a); then FORCE a = 1 on FACE pixels with d > 15000 and a = 0 on TOP pixels.
STEP 6 — COMPOSITE: FINAL = cloud canvas (RGB, alpha a) OVER BASE (premultiplied), straight alpha out.
STEP 7 — CHECKS: (a) FACE pixels with d > 13000 and FINAL alpha < 0.95 — count (target 0) and bboxes of groups ≥ 100 px; (b) mean |FINAL − BASE| RGB over pixels with d < 6000 (target ~0); (c) per column, the depth (mm) at the first face pixel from the top where a ≥ 0.5: p10/p50/p90; (d) per column, the void extent below the face bottom where a ≥ 0.5: p10/p50/p90 px; (e) seam stats as before.
STEP 8 — OUTPUTS: out/foreground.png (5376×4096 RGBA), out/foreground_preview_1344x1024.png (over #3a3f4a), out/band_detail_crops.png (4 full-res 640×640 crops: two on the far canyon face, one on the near face below the path, one under the bridge — over #3a3f4a), out/checks.json, out/summary.txt ≤ 14 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 14 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-asm-fg-v4-band"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
